description.value: Brasserie L'école is a classic French brasserie in the heart of downtown Victoria, serving seasonal, locally sourced ingredients prepared in a French-country style. The restaurant is known for its curated selection of Belgian and French beers alongside a wine list that emphasises French regional varieties and value. Touring cyclists looking for a destination sit-down meal in Victoria will find classic brasserie fare — moules et frites, duck confit, beef tartare — on a menu updated daily.
